title: Mitosis architecture audit and rebuild exploration

completion_criteria.text: Foundational audit of the current engine complete across all four domains: two-layer fan-out, durability/resume, cost/latency, pipeline rigidity + fragility
External research verdict delivered on whether the architecture is correct, with disconfirming pass and cited prior art
The child_process runtime-capability question settled empirically (does dynamic import of node:child_process EXECUTE inside a Workflow script, not merely resolve)

Three open architecture decisions resolved by the user: adopt an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime vs only its state model; default speculation depth given that rework costs tokens not machine time; which work-type pipelines to define first
An approved architecture spec for the rebuild exists, superseding or explicitly scoping the six paused repair-oriented mitosis threads

spine.active_goal: M5 IS COMMITTED BUT NOT SHIPPED; STAGE 1 OF 0192 IS CLOSED. The 12 staged paths landed as ba981cc on feat/m5-quiescent-exit, 1 ahead of origin/main 42e7d49, NOT pushed, no PR. That commit discharged the M1 landing obligation (the coverage gate now exits 0 in BOTH modes) and dissolved 0191's two manufactured findings; the suite is verified first-hand at 1845 pass / 0 fail. Stage 1's two-agent audit of the rival termination remedies is ruled by 0193. Nothing is running.

open_risks: ba981cc is UNPUSHED - safe in git but only locally. Push early in Stage 2. The old destroy-by-checkout/reset/stash/clean risk is discharged.

D2 STILL OWED: the M6 row's 'the staged set is empty' was FALSE when written. Do not just delete the clause, and do not let it stand because ba981cc has since made it accidentally true. invariant-coverage-check.mjs never checks whether a string is TRUE.

D3 DECLARED RESIDUAL: exit removal is a full-suite HANG with zero reddening, and NEITHER remedy recovers the suite exit code. The sole await is Promise.allSettled([]), microtasks only, so { timeout: N } cannot fire. Declare it; never imply it is fixed. See 0193.

ORDERING RULE FROM 0194, most easily got wrong: do NOT tell any Stage 2 agent not to commit. Every lens runs AFTER the commit that produces what it measures. The inverse manufactured two of M5's four blockers.

The engine is .claude/workflows/mitosis.js, NOT under .claude/lib/superpowers-parallel/. mirror-guard classifies BOTH leases.mjs AND reconcile.mjs as WHOLE. Tests are not policed twins - confirm that against MIRROR_CENSUS rather than assuming it.

ALL :line CITES ARE AT 42e7d49; THE TREE IS NOW ba981cc. Re-derive every anchor by grep. Both auditors did: the quiescent exit is leases.mjs:160 / mitosis.js:2386, the two loops byte-identical modulo the export prefix.
M5 TOUCHES POLICED TWINS - every twin edit lands in BOTH files in ONE commit, and landing stays SERIAL. Re-derive the twin surface per change; 0151 established the gotcha list is incomplete.

THE M4 TRAP: never rewrite a characterization test's assertions in the same commit as the behavior change. Deleting merge-poll-characterization.test.mjs with the mechanism it pinned was CORRECT and is already in ba981cc.
Give each workflow agent a DISTINCT scratch subdirectory. Applied in wjy3c80jv and again in the Stage 1 audit; no collision recurred.

Five pre-existing dirty paths persist (.claude/settings.json, .zshrc, two .bak files, .claude/skills/context7-mcp/) - verified untouched across the commit and both audits. Stage explicit paths only, NEVER git add -A.

PR scope is FROZEN at creation; title/body edits are denied, later facts go in a comment (0142). pr-create rejects angle brackets in --what and requires --provenance when --origin machine. Merge stays human-gated.
NEVER invoke the compiled workflow. leases.mjs exports runSchedule directly, so a lib-side test needs no AsyncFunction harness and no MITOSIS_PATH; coverage composes through mirror-guard instead.

Method rule, TEN instances deep and now applied to the orchestrator's OWN recommendation in 0193: verify a confident finding against the mechanism, and prove a probe CAN redden before believing a null result.
out_of_scope: Any change at mitosis.js:4058-4061. H-C is REFUTED by 0159, not deferred - the done-union is correct and narrowing it is a liveness regression. Re-opening needs new evidence of an unconfirmed-ship producer.

Executing run-readiness-repair's MSP-0..MSP-10. Quiescent-advance M0..M8 lands first, and the overlap (M0/M1 against MSP-6/MSP-7) must be reconciled before that spec is scheduled.
Pipelines for refactor, perf, docs or chore - closed by 0118. Limits PIPELINES only, not the PR title type vocabulary.
The feat pipeline - 0110 sequences it second, after the fix pipeline proves the effector boundary.

Bootstrapping a target repo's test infrastructure as a side effect of shipping - closed by 0117; that is verify-setup, human-invoked.
Adopting an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime - closed by 0108. A webhook, server or daemon for the relaunch trigger - closed by 0119.
fileScope-only task-edge derivation - rejected by 0116, settled by 0120.
Cluster-aware scheduling and the journal's 2000-char model-output paging - fenced out by spec section 1.
Dispatching or restarting any target-repo mitosis run.
